title: Demon Slayer
description: Demon Slayer has become one of the most recognized modern anime series and continues to attract fans around the world.
fullDetails: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba is a popular Japanese anime series based on the manga written and illustrated by Koyoharu Gotouge. The story follows Tanjiro Kamado, a kind-hearted young boy whose life changes after a demon attacks his family.

title: Valorant: The Tactical Shooter
description: Valorant is based around 5-versus-5 team matches. Players choose different agents, each with their own abilities and role.
fullDetails: Valorant is a popular tactical first-person shooter developed by Riot Games. The game combines precise gunplay with unique character abilities, creating a competitive experience where teamwork, strategy, and quick decision-making are important.

title: Call of Duty: A Legendary Shooter
description: Call of Duty offers a fast and action-packed gaming experience built around combat, teamwork, competition, and storytelling.
fullDetails: Call of Duty is one of the most famous first-person shooter franchises in gaming. Known for intense combat, cinematic campaigns, multiplayer battles, and competitive gameplay, the series has attracted millions of players around the world.
